messages.subject: [R-sig-Epi] Epidemiological Prevalence Assessment using R (Free Webinar this Tuesday)
messages.subject_clean: Epidemiological Prevalence Assessment using R (Free Webinar this Tuesday)
messages.body_plain:
Hello R Users,

Are you interested in using R to perform prevalence assessment studies on
epidemiological data?

This free one-hour webinar will provide a general introduction to
"prevalence", an R package that provides a collection of functions used to
perform prevalence assessment studies.

Webinar Format:
- Introduction to the prevalence R package
- Live demonstration
- Question and Answer period

Speaker:
Brecht Devleesschauwer - Doctoral Researcher at Gent University and the
"prevalence" package maintainer

Moderator:
Ray DiGiacomo, Jr. - President of The Orange County R User Group

Webinar Date/Time:
October 22, 2013 at 10 am Pacific Time (California Time)

Webinar Registration Site:
https://www3.gotomeeting.com/register/278262270

For more information on the prevalence package, please visit:
http://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/prevalence

This event is brought to you by The Orange County R User Group.

Please note that in addition to attending from your laptop or desktop
computer, you can also attend from a Wi-Fi connected iPhone, iPad, Android
phone or Android tablet by installing the GoToMeeting App.

Best Regards,

The Orange County R User Group

	[[alternative HTML version deleted]]
